Definition: Integrates security practices into software delivery from planning through operations
Balances confidentiality integrity and availability in security decisions
Moves security checks earlier in the lifecycle to reduce downstream risk and cost
Systematically identifies attack paths trust boundaries and mitigations before implementation
Static Application Security Testing reviews source or bytecode without executing the app
Dynamic Application Security Testing probes a running application externally
Software Composition Analysis identifies third-party components and known vulnerabilities
Software Bill of Materials inventories software components for dependency transparency
Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures provides standardized vulnerability identifiers
Common Vulnerability Scoring System rates vulnerability severity consistently
Continuous Integration frequently merges changes with automated build and test checks
Continuous Delivery Deployment automates release flow after quality and security gates
Stores CI/CD workflow definitions in version control for repeatability and review
Infrastructure as Code provisions environments from versioned configuration files
Grants only the minimum permissions required to complete a task
Role-Based Access Control assigns permissions to roles then users inherit role permissions
Attribute-Based Access Control evaluates user resource and context attributes for authorization
Multi-Factor Authentication requires two or more factor categories for login
Privileged Access Management controls audits and limits elevated account usage
Authentication Authorization and Accounting verify identity permit actions and record activity
Transport Layer Security encrypts data in transit and protects integrity
HTTP over TLS secures browser-server communication against interception and tampering
Public Key Infrastructure manages certificates trust chains and key validation
Hash-based Message Authentication Code combines a shared secret and hash function for integrity authenticity checks
Transforms input data into a fixed-length digest for integrity-oriented use cases
Adds unique random data before password hashing to resist precomputed attacks
Rejects malformed or unsafe input by enforcing expected type format and range
Encodes untrusted data for its output context so browsers treat it as data not code
Occurs when untrusted input changes intended SQL query structure
Cross-Site Scripting executes attacker-controlled script in a user browser context
Cross-Site Request Forgery tricks a logged-in browser into sending unintended state-changing requests
Content Security Policy restricts allowed content sources to reduce script injection impact
Security Information and Event Management centralizes and correlates logs for detection and response
Intrusion Detection System monitors traffic events to detect suspicious behavior
JSON Web Token is a compact claims token that must be validated carefully
Delegated authorization framework that grants scoped access without sharing user passwords
Stores and rotates credentials through controlled vaulting instead of hardcoding
Assumes no implicit trust and continuously verifies identity device and context
